claims.claim: getAllowedHostTransitions reads the AllowedHostTransitions property from the indexed host-state service and object on the xyz.openbmc_project.State.Host interface, binding the response to afterGetAllowedHostTransitions.
afterGetAllowedHostTransitions initializes every allowable ResetType list with ForceOff, PowerCycle, and Nmi before processing either an error or the returned D-Bus transitions.

For bad_request_descriptor or host_unreachable errors, afterGetAllowedHostTransitions treats AllowedHostTransitions as unavailable and appends On, ForceOn, ForceRestart, GracefulRestart, and GracefulShutdown to the default ResetTypes.
For any other D-Bus error, afterGetAllowedHostTransitions records an internal error and returns before constructing or publishing the Parameters array.

dbusToRfAllowedHostTransitions maps On to On and ForceOn, Off to GracefulShutdown, GracefulWarmReboot to GracefulRestart, and ForceWarmReboot to ForceRestart; unsupported transitions only produce a warning.

The GetAllowedHostTransition tests verify that an unexpected invalid_argument error returns Internal Server Error, while a missing D-Bus property returns the complete fallback ResetType parameter list.
